yit.definition: Thus far; up to the present; up to some unspecified time.

yonder.definition: At or in a distant but indicated place.

york.definition: To bowl a yorker at a batsman, especially to get a batsman out in this way.

you.definition: To address (a person) using the pronoun you (in the past, especially to use you rather than thou, when you was considered more formal).

young.definition: In the early part of growth or life; born not long ago.

youth.definition: The quality or state of being young.

youths.definition: The quality or state of being young.

yowled.definition: A prolonged, loud cry, like the sound of an animal; a wail; a howl.

yucca.definition: Any of several evergreen plants of the genus Yucca, having long, pointed, and rigid leaves at the top of a woody stem, and bearing a large panicle of showy white blossoms.
